## Cluster sizes

```{r cluster-sizes}
clust_long <- read.csv(chapter_table("cluster_size_summary.csv"),
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
tbl <- clust_long[clust_long$resolution == paste0("res.", marker_res),
                  c("cluster", "n_cells", "pct_cells")]
tbl$cluster <- factor(tbl$cluster, levels = tbl$cluster[order(-tbl$n_cells)])

ggplot(tbl, aes(x = cluster, y = n_cells)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct_cells, 1), "%")), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  labs(title = paste0("Cluster sizes — ", subset_label, "  (res ", marker_res, ")"),
       x = "Cluster", y = "# cells") +
  theme_bw()
```

---

# Markers

Top 10 differentially expressed genes per cluster (resolution `r marker_res`).

```{r markers-table}
markers <- read.csv(chapter_table(paste0("cluster_markers_res", marker_res, ".csv")),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
top_markers <- markers |>
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 10) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(cluster, gene, avg_log2FC, pct.1, pct.2, p_val_adj) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    avg_log2FC = round(avg_log2FC, 3),
    pct.1      = round(pct.1, 3),
    pct.2      = round(pct.2, 3),
    p_val_adj  = signif(p_val_adj, 3)
  )
DT::datatable(
  top_markers,
  caption  = "Top 10 markers per cluster (ranked by avg_log2FC)",
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter   = "top",
  options  = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE)
)
```
